tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of 2 Nos. of 10MVA, 2.2/66kV, 3 Phase, Generator Transformers for Shimsha Hydro electric station including supervision of its erection, testing and commissioning.
tenderSchedule.description: Design, Manufacture, Supply, Quality Surveillance, Testing at suppliers works, Transportation, Unloading at site, Delivery on FOR destination basis, arranging transit insurance, providing guarantees, Supervision of Erection, Testing & Commissioning of two numbers of 10MVA, 2.2/66kV, OFWF, 3-Phase Generator Transformers for Shimsha Hydro Electric Station.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Chief Engineer ED office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Chief Engineer (Electrical Designs), Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd., No.3, 3rd Floor, Green building, Palace Road.

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall have satisfactorily completed the work of Design, manufacture, supply of minimum 1 No. of 10 MVA, 2.2/66KV, 3 Phase Generator Transformer or higher capacity Generator Transformer to State/Central Generating Utilities or any organization in India & the same shall have satisfactorily performed for a minimum period of one year during the preceding five years (One-year satisfactory performance period should have been completed as on the date of issue of tender). As a proof of this, Bidder shall furnish copy of performance certificate and corresponding work order having value not less than Rs.2.0 Crores issued by an officer of the rank of Chief Engineer or Station Superintendent / Competent Authority of the Power Station/Sub-station.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- performance certificate and corresponding work order having value not less than Rs.2.0 Crores

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending Bidder shall be a regular manufacturer of Transformers of 66KV or higher voltage class Transformers in India

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of factory license (Form-3) or Certificate of Incorporation (Form-1) or Company Registration Certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending Bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years, a minimum financial turnover of Rs.8.02 Crores during the last five years period i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Turn Over Certificate / P&L statements / annual report duly audited and certified by the Chartered accountant and bearing valid UDIN

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall not have been subjected to forfeiture of EMD/foreclosure/termination of their Contract in KPCL or Government or any other utility or shall not have been blacklisted for participating in tender by KPCL, Government, or any other utility in India during the past three years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- notarized declaration to satisfy the above as specified in Schedule-16

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Procurement of 2 Nos. of 10MVA, 2.2/66kV, 3 Phase, Generator Transformers for Shimsha Hydro electric station including supervision of its erection, testing and commissioning.

itemList.description: Design, Manufacture, Quality surveillance, Supply, testing (Routine, Type & Special tests)at supplier's works, transportation, unloading at site, delivery on FOR destination basis, arranging transit insurance, providing guarantees for 2X10 MVA, 2.2/66 kV,3 phase, OFWF cooled Generator Transformers as per KPCL bid requirements with first filling of oil plus 10% extra quantity of oil in non-returnable drums.
Supply of essential spares as listed in bid document.
Charges towards Supervision of Erection,Testing & Commissioning for 15 man days for each transformer.
